notes: the baos really play with whatever you give them now
two things a day, plus one new bao
the zapper is gone; there is a camera instead
party poppers and bags of treats turn up now and then
the diary is a proper book you can turn the pages of
a little tune of their own, with its own button
you can add one new bao a day, next to today's things
somebody is always awake now, even at three in the morning
every floor has its own stairs and a ladder, inside the rooms
the baos never stop building now: a porch, a garden, courts, a bowling alley, even a lake
stairs! no more ladders between floors
the bathroom and one bedroom got a front wall and a big window
press and hold furniture to move it to any room
double-tap a bao to zoom in and follow it
new things arrive at midnight, with a countdown
this update button
added sound effects
the diary repeats itself less
baos hold still when you vaporize them
the tiny bao community opened its doors
